name: The Bungalow
description: A family-run Pleasant Grove reception venue with French-country, old-world character (stone, ivy, gardens, a gazebo, vaulted ceilings and a fireplace). The whole facility is booked exclusively, with indoor and outdoor spaces, ivory linens, centerpieces, a sound system and an event coordinator included.
seatedText:
70 indoors for a sit-down dinner
165 chairs total

Features > Outdoors.wording: Outdoor space for up to 350 guests

Decor > String / bistro lights.wording: Indoor and outdoor bistro and twinkle lights

items.label: Description
items.value: A family-run Pleasant Grove reception venue with French-country, old-world character (stone, ivy, gardens, a gazebo, vaulted ceilings and a fireplace). The whole facility is booked exclusively, with indoor and outdoor spaces, ivory linens, centerpieces, a sound system and an event coordinator included.

items.label: Style words
items.value:
Old-world charm
French country
European country estate
Modern-day elegance

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Ceremony added to a reception (1 extra hour) — $750 peak (70 guests max) / $550 off-peak indoor (40 guests max)
Ceremony only, no reception (Tuesday-Thursday, 3 hours) — $1,000
Special events (Tuesday-Thursday, 3 hours) — $1,500
Additional hour for a luncheon — $500
Bungalow staff — $25 per hour per staff member
Alcohol privilege fee — $600

items.label: Deposit
items.value:
$700 nonrefundable retainer secures the date
Final payment due 30 days before the event
4% fee on credit/debit cards; cash, cashier's checks and checks accepted

items.label: Outdoors
items.value: Outdoor space for up to 350 guests

items.label: Seated
items.value:
70 indoors for a sit-down dinner
165 chairs total

items.label: Ceremony with reception
items.value: Price: $750 peak (outdoor or indoor, 70 max) / $550 off-peak (indoor, 40 max) · Includes: 1 extra hour; chair setup/takedown; music; rehearsal; coordination

items.label: Ceremony only
items.value: Price: $1,000 · Days: Tuesday-Thursday · Includes: 3-hour block; indoor (40 max) or outdoor (70 max); chairs; music; rehearsal; coordination

items.label: Rain plan
items.value: In inclement weather an outdoor ceremony may be moved indoors

items.label: Included items
items.value:
Centerpieces
Standing and table easels
Ivory linens
Bistro lights (indoor and outdoor)
Twinkle lights (indoor and outdoor)
Lanterns on shepherd's hooks (outdoors)
Cake table
Sign-in table
Gift table
Tables and chairs

items.label: Staff & coordination
items.value:
Event coordinator included with all bookings
Bungalow staff for table clearing and cleanup — $25 per hour per staff member

items.label: Setup & cleanup
items.value:
Partial: venue staff take down venue-provided items and clean restrooms
Host and vendors clean up everything they bring, including catering and send-off mess
Staff to help clean up — $25 per hour per staff member

items.label: Equipment
items.value:
Yes
Sound system (indoors and outdoors)
Wireless microphone
TV for slideshows (HDTV indoors; DVD, thumb drive or laptop)

items.label: String / bistro lights
items.value: Indoor and outdoor bistro and twinkle lights

items.label: For rent
items.value:
Large selection of decor (ask venue for details)
Kitchen supplies

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Exclusive use of building and gardens
Dining hall
Greeting room
Gazebo with 3 serving tables
Indoor serving buffet
Fireplace
Wireless internet
DVD player
Birdcage for cards
Ceremony add-on (with reception) — $750 peak / $550 off-peak
Additional hour for a luncheon — $500
Bungalow staff — $25 per hour per staff member

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Outside caterer required: any established, professional caterer (must sign Brought-In Food Policy)
No food made by family or friends
Caterer or host provides plates, cups, utensils, napkins, water dispenser and ice

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value:
Kitchen for warming and prepping (caterer completes a checklist)
No ice maker; limited freezer space

items.label: Alcohol
items.value:
Beer and wine only
$600 alcohol privilege fee
Licensed, insured bartender required; host or bartender supplies alcohol, cups and ice

items.label: Sparklers
items.value:
No
Sparklers, fireworks and floating lanterns not allowed (fire hazard)

items.label: Times
items.value:
3:00pm-9:00pm or 4:00pm-10:00pm
Peak (April-October): Tuesday-Saturday
Off-peak (November-March): Tuesday-Saturday
Closed Sunday

items.label: Rental length
items.value:
6 hours (reception)
3 hours (ceremony only or special event)

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
No sparklers, fireworks or floating lanterns
No confetti
Music off by 10:00pm (city ordinance)
No dogs
No early access, drop-offs or storage before the event
Furniture moved only by venue staff
Cake must be from an established professional baker
Host cleans up send-off and vehicle-decorating mess

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Whole facility is booked exclusively
Off-peak season: outdoor tables and chairs are stored for winter
Ceremony capacity: 70 outdoors / 40 indoors
Tours by appointment only; closed Sunday

items.label: Special events
items.value: Price: $1,500 · Days: Tuesday-Thursday · Includes: 3-hour block; all amenities

rules.note: Beer and wine only; licensed bartender; $600 fee
